Overview

Yamaguchi is a city in Yamaguchi with a population of 195,000. A small historic city in western Honshu with a beautiful castle, five-story pagoda, and some of Japan’s lowest living costs. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
